name: MailChimp for Magento 2
headline: MailChimp for Magento 2 - Email Marketing
short_description: Syncs Magento 2 data with MailChimp for email campaigns, automations, ads, and postcards. Benefits marketing teams by automating customer engagement and improving campaign performance.
author: mailchimp

sections.overview:
The mc-magento2 skill connects your Magento 2 store directly to MailChimp, enabling seamless synchronization of customer and product data for targeted email marketing. This integration allows marketing teams to build automated email campaigns, manage customer lists, and track campaign performance without manual data entry. By syncing Magento 2 data with MailChimp's platform, you can leverage customer behavior and purchase history to create personalized email sequences and promotional campaigns. The skill reduces manual work, improves data accuracy, and helps ecommerce teams execute coordinated marketing strategies that drive customer engagement and repeat sales.
Automatically sync Magento 2 customer lists to MailChimp for targeted email campaigns
Trigger automated email sequences based on customer purchase behavior and order history
Create segmented email campaigns using Magento product and customer data
Maintain real-time data consistency between Magento 2 and MailChimp platforms
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mailchimp/mc-magento2`
sections.usage:
```
Sync the Magento 2 store data for [STORE_NAME] with MailChimp. Ensure customer segments are updated based on [CRITERIA] such as purchase history, cart abandonment, or customer lifetime value. Set up automated email campaigns for [CAMPAIGN_TYPE] like welcome series, abandoned cart reminders, or loyalty rewards.
```
Copy

```
The Magento 2 to MailChimp sync has been successfully completed for the store 'FashionFusion'. Customer segments have been updated based on purchase history and cart abandonment criteria. The following segments are now available in MailChimp: 'High-Value Customers', 'Abandoned Cart Users', and 'New Customers'. Automated email campaigns have been set up for the following types: 'Welcome Series', 'Abandoned Cart Reminders', and 'Loyalty Rewards'. The welcome series will send a series of three emails over the first week of a new customer's journey, while the abandoned cart reminders will trigger 1 hour, 1 day, and 3 days after cart abandonment. The loyalty rewards campaign will target customers who have made 5 or more purchases and will offer a 10% discount on their next purchase.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
